evidence.text: Hannah was seen in clinic today following a first referral. She has a diagnosis of focal epilepsy.
Her last focal seizure occurred on 15 July 2023. We initiated levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily. She has experienced no further seizures since starting medication.
We will review her in six to nine months.
Hannah re-attended clinic today after an eighteen-month interval, having missed scheduled interim appointments. Her diagnosis remains focal epilepsy.

She explained that she discontinued levetiracetam on her own initiative in early 2024. She remained relatively well until 12 February 2025, when she suffered an explosive cluster of three generalized convulsive seizures within twelve hours, prompting emergency department admission and intravenous lorazepam. No other seizure types occurred. She was restarted on levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily in hospital.
We strongly counseled adherence and maintained levetiracetam. No EEG requested today. Review in four months.

Hannah attended for review. She reports full adherence to levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily. She has remained entirely seizure-free since her discharge following the February cluster, with no events between 13 February and 15 June 2025.
Treatment maintained. Follow-up in six months.
